Your family may have handed you a money story you never chose.

Kevin explains that blocks around money can be passed down through generations, and that some families carry far more of them than others.

He lists the phrases many of us grew up hearing: money doesn't grow on trees, it's hard to make money, we're not smart enough.

Which money sentence did you hear most growing up?
